title: Gargantuan Evolutions
description: Cobblemon and Create Modpack, with Quality of Life additions. Built with a Vanilla++ experience in mind, and an enjoyable multiplayer experience
body:
# **Gargantuan Evolutions**
![Gargantuan Evolutions Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/449c16e5f9dd0fb629d9c88d4155759bd1676fa6.png)

**Gargantuan Evolutions** is a **Cobblemon** + **Create** Modpack designed with the idea of Pokemon Catching, Exploration and Create contraptions in mind. This is a culmination of mods and addons for both Cobblemon and Create to enhance the experience together and elevate those two mods to being even more incredible.

This was designed Specifically for a group named Gargantuan and this modpack was made to make it easier for everyone to join the Gargantuan SMP

| **Cobblemon Addons**    | **Create Addons**         | **Other Mods**           |
|---------------------|:---------------------:|---------------------:|
| Badgebox            | Crafts & Additions    | Journey Map          |
| Cobbreeding         | Enchantment Industry  | Iris Shaders         |
| AllTheMons          | Cell 3:2              | Cell 3:3             |
| Ascension Megamons  | Jetpack               | Farmers Delight      |
| Legends Untold      | Slice and Dice        | Toms Simple Storage  |
| Fight or Flight     | Cobblemon Integration | AND MORE             |
| Boenk's Item Desc.  | Dynamic Villages      |                      |
| CobbleHats          | New Age               |                      |
| Show Held Items     | Steam 'n' Rails       |                      |
| Capture EXP         |                       |                      |
| Cobblemon Interface |                       |                      |
| Mass Outbreaks      |                       |                      |
| Cobbledex + Pokenav |                       |                      |
| AND MORE            |                       |                      |
